items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: he was the one who really worked very hard and drew up the proposals, under which we merged.

ctx.x: But I think, notably, I might mention Marl Young, who is the secretary of Local 47, now, and he is black, and he is a Chicago musician who also has a law degree. And he was the one who really worked very hard and drew up the proposals, under which we merged.

And if I am correct, I think the proposals that he drew up were so well done that they were just accepted in toto, or just as they were delivered, you know -- and Marl deserves a lot of credit. A lot of people say that Benny Carter was the one, but I feel it was Marl, and I always give the credit to him.
Well, of course, he gives a lot of credit to you.
